verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth is an authentication and authorization service, so scheduling recurring jobs or workflows falls outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Auth itself shipping a scheduler. Its lifecycle hooks and triggers (supabase-docs-7, supabase-docs-2) are event-driven responses, not recurring schedules, and do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
